title: Time Jump — 18:45

fields.narration: Time jump: It is now 18:45 on Friday, March 13, 2026. The first 14 patients from the multi-vehicle crash with the fuel tanker arrived at 17:10. The second wave of 22 patients arrived at 18:00. A total of 36 crash patients have now been received. Eleven remain critical. Four are in the operating room. The PACU is holding six ICU overflow patients. The ED holds 64 patients. ICU 3 North and ICU 3 South have no free beds. The replacement core network switch is en route via courier; estimated time of arrival is 21:30.
